info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Portfolio Insights API
info.description: The Product Portfolio Insights API provides access to detailed analyses of business product portfolios. This endpoint allows users to retrieve valuable information about various financial products offered to businesses, facilitating informed decision-making. Typical consumers include business analysts, financial advisors, and product managers who need to evaluate product performance and align offerings with market demands. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their strategic planning and optimize product development efforts.

get.summary: Retrieve product portfolio details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific product portfolio using its unique identifier (ID). It provides insights into the product's attributes, performance, and related metrics.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving product portfolio analysis data for the specified product ID (PROD-700045). This request allows clients to define the necessary parameters and filters for fetching relevant analysis insights.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been returned.
